column3: Close to the Hebrew; “whirring of wings” is rendered “shadowed with buzzing wings,” and לְנַהֲרֵי־ כוּשׁ “Ethiopia.”
Close to the Hebrew; NKJV supplies “saying,” and “a nation of line-line” is rendered “A nation powerful.”
Close to the Hebrew; “I will remain quiet” is rendered “I will take My rest,” and “in My place” “from My dwelling place.”
Close to the Hebrew; “tendrils” is rendered “branches.”
Close to the Hebrew; “a gift” is rendered “a present,” and “a people” “From a people.”
